Acme Corp - Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

Operator: Good afternoon and welcome to the Acme Corp third quarter 2026 earnings conference call.

Jane Smith, Chief Executive Officer: Thank you, operator. We delivered a solid third quarter.
Total revenue for Q3 2026 was $4.2 billion, up 8 percent year over year, driven by strong demand
in our cloud services segment. Operating margin expanded to 21 percent.

John Lee, Chief Financial Officer: Thanks, Jane. Looking ahead, for the fourth quarter of 2026 we
expect revenue in the range of $4.4 billion to $4.6 billion. We expect full-year 2026 earnings per
share between $3.10 and $3.20.

On risks: supply chain delays in Asia continue to constrain hardware shipments, and we expect this
to weigh on fourth quarter results. We are also monitoring foreign exchange headwinds from a
stronger dollar, which had a modest impact this quarter.

Operator: That concludes today's call. Thank you for joining.
